failure_outcome: diagnostics (low): every HA-reachable press refuses (fail-closed, zero writes - the guard holds) but the texts misstate the cause (FP 'snapshot data cannot be trusted (unreadable or invalid)' for a readable record; in this mirror the Dump End refusal replaces the PR41 'dual durable obligation' text until the next boot) and Force answers 'only available while an operator decision is required' next to 'deliberate operator recovery required'
notes: Finding F-HF07-5 (FINDING-NEW, narrowed; DUPLICATE of F-FW01-3, not counted: its HA-reachable extension, same root). In mirror a the SG-02 containment text replaces the PR41 text about 13 s after boot with no owner action, then the Dump End refusal replaces that (suite [6]). The Energy Actions card offers only Dump End under RECOVERY BLOCKED; FP End and Dump Force need raw button-entity presses (INFERRED, the card is not modelled). That no HA surface resolves the lockout is documented by design (out-of-band exit). Real-world reachability UNKNOWN, likely low: with ESPHome 2026.8.2 the marker commit directly follows a successful data commit whose sync() cleared the pending queue, so only an own-key landed-then-error marker commit (ESP-IDF REMOVE_FAILED on a flash-operation failure; REPORTED, not checked offline) can create the phantom; the unrelated-pending-key route in the firmware comment cannot at this commit. V0.1 (B5 NVS used-key rule): a completed-lease prelude - a 1 min scheduled Dump to Grid lease at 11:52 through its own HA schedule (STARTED OK, lease end, verified restore 'RESTORED OK - original inverter settings verified', marker CLEAR) - stores the dump.valid marker key before the injection; the 12:00 schedule is armed at 11:55 and the fault at 11:55:30 (V0 injected on the never-used key, which the only device route left for a marker false negative, ESP-IDF REMOVE_FAILED, cannot produce). Outcome unchanged by the prelude; suite [10] replays the prelude alone up to the main schedule's arm (+300 s: a real lease completed) and refuses this document with the prelude removed.
ownership: synthetic site (L.SITE ORIGINAL); the owner arms the schedules in Home Assistant; HA (FPS1 / DGS1 / SMR1) and the dongle firmware are the only writers; the injected Phase-B marker commit false negative (record lands, commit returns False) is the only fault
smallest_safe_repair_scope: firmware text-only, reusing the designed S4 FB-B1 retention (RAM-only *_lockout_cause, cause 6 DUAL_FP_DUMP): key the FP boot / START / END BLOCKED texts, the Dump Recovery State, the Dump End refusal and the SG-02 containment text on the cause; PR41 also publishes a dual-obligation free_power_status; the Force refusal tests the corrupt flag first (text only). Keep the 'RECOVERY BLOCKED' prefix and phrases the card relies on. No gate change, no Modbus or durable write; the reconciliation path itself is FW-01 scope.

source_anchors.text: if (id(free_power_recovery_metadata_corrupt)) id(free_power_status).publish_state("END BLOCKED - RECOVERY BLOCKED: durable recovery marker exists but its snapshot data cannot be trusted (unreadable or invalid); deliberate recovery required");
if (!id(dump_operator_needed)) id(dump_status).publish_state("REJECTED - Force Restore is only available while an operator decision is required");
